scope: Item 3: document register, evidence and lifecycle for the existing six source types

checks.repeat_policy: Only failed cases rerun after fixture/assertion fixes; isolated integration reused validated post-payment fixture after AP success
checks.disposable_postgres: all six snapshot kinds and PDFs; PO numbering; original export contention; AP idempotency/overpayment; revision/cancellation/replacement/credit-note linkage; profile freezing; scope; immutable triggers; atomic GR evidence rollback
checks.uat_smoke: six histories read without writes, deployed backend healthy
checks.rollback: old backend read expanded schema on isolated clone; real UAT image rollback executed automatically on first smoke-script failure
checks.deploy_attempts: First reverted due to smoke script using route.path on FastAPI _IncludedRouter. Corrected script uses OpenAPI paths; candidate read checks passed; second deployment passed. Application image unchanged between attempts.

rollback.schema_policy: Keep doclife0030, snapshots and events. Never restore/drop the database for application rollback.
rollback.operations_policy: Pause document issuance/revision while older writers are active until forward recovery.

limits: Accountant acceptance, official tax-form acceptance and physical printing are pending.
Checksums are not digital signatures; immutable HTML/payload is stored, not exact PDF bytes.
Legacy documents remain explicitly non-snapshot; no historical reconstruction.
Supplier invoice archive is an internal receiving register, not the supplier-issued original or attachment vault.
PO revisions apply to drafts; issued corrections use cancel/replacement and tax credit notes through existing source workflows.
No new arbitrary payment/GR cancellation bypass; no new tax filing or production flag enabled.
Existing database routing retained; Takeaway PO/GR and unconnected Retail procurement tables are not migrated into this registry.
